indian.text: No permit. Your hotel or homestay registers you on the state tourism app at check-in (since June 2025). Self-drive rental cars for tourists are not allowed, and registered guides are required for treks in East Khasi Hills, including Nongriat.

foreign.text: No special permit. Hotels register foreign guests (Form C). Registered guides are required for treks in East Khasi Hills.

indian.text: No permit. National parks charge entry, camera and safari fees.

foreign.text: No special permit. Hotels register foreign guests; parks charge a higher foreigner entry fee.

indian.text: Inner Line Permit required. Apply online at eilp.arunachal.gov.in; the 2026 Temporary ILP costs about ₹300–500 (pay what the portal shows), covers the whole state for 15 days and is checked at gates such as Bhalukpong and Banderdewa.

foreign.text: Protected Area Permit through an approved tour operator, usually for groups of two or more (solo travellers reportedly limited to Tawang, Bomdila and Ziro). Royalty reported at USD 30–50; valid 30 days.

areas.name: Bum La Pass and Madhuri Lake (Tawang)

indian.text: Separate pass from the Deputy Commissioner's office in Tawang, stamped by the Army. Local SUVs only; runs only in clear weather and closes after snow.
Inner Line Permit, online only: about ₹200 for 30 days. Carry a printout or the e-ILP on your phone.

foreign.text: Protected Area Permit required again since 17 December 2024, arranged through an approved operator.

indian.text: Inner Line Permit: about ₹120 for 15 days, extendable by 15. Apply online or at the Lengpui airport counter.

foreign.text: Protected Area Permit required again since December 2024, and police registration within 24 hours of arrival.

indian.text: Inner Line Permit required (30 days). Travel advisories apply in parts of the state; we check current conditions before planning any Manipur trip.

foreign.text: Protected Area Permit required again since December 2024. Several governments advise against non-essential travel; check the current advisory.
